Worktree /home/azureuser/pawse-video is a detached HEAD at origin/main 0514167 (#65).

**1. Phone-call flow (web/src)**
- App.jsx:31 `view` is home | voice | clinics | phone | plan. `pickClinic` (App.jsx:98) sets the clinic, sets `target='vet'` and goes to 'phone'. `call(to)` (~93) sets the target and opens 'phone'. `callDone` (107-111) stores `setVet(result)` or `setInsurance(result)`, then goes to 'plan'. App.jsx:68 renders `LiveHandoff` when IS_LIVE_PHONE and not in rehearsal; otherwise it renders `PhoneCall`. Context passed in (148-153): `gradiumConsent, voice, summary, clinic, estimate, homeVisitFee`.
- Call kinds: only `'vet'` and `'insurance'`. There are no confirmation, taxi or calendar calls in React.
- **mockScripts.js:56-176** `phoneScripts.{vet,insurance}.lines`. A line is `{who:'ai'|'callee', step?:{en,zh}, de, text:{en,zh}}`. A question node is `{question:{id:'slot', text, options:[{id:'practice',label},{id:'home',label}], fallback:'practice'}, branches:{practice:[...], home:[...]}}` (75-136). This is the only home-visit vs clinic choice, shown as `.ask-card` buttons (PhoneCall.jsx:251-264). Scripts have no `simulated` flag: mockPhoneAgent adds it to events.
- **livePhoneAgent.js** fetches `/api/v1/demo/mimi` (30) and maps `steps[2]` for vet and `steps[3]` for insurance (24, 236). It maps `{speaker,german,subtitle}` to `{who, original, text}`. Callee lines get `simulated:true` (251). It has **no `answer()` and no question events**, so live mode never shows an ask-card.
- Event contract: contracts.js:59-67 (`line {who, original, text, simulated?}`, `progress`, `question {id,text,options}`, `answered`, `result`). Result shapes are at contracts.js:74-77:
  - vet: `{kind:'appointment', time, place, estimate, currency, note?, homeVisitFee?}`
  - insurance: `{kind:'coverage', covered, deductible, rate, estimate, reimbursed, outOfPocket, points:[{ok,text,ref?}]}`
  - Both also carry `simulated`.
- Outcome storage: App `vet` / `insurance` state. Mock `buildVetResult(lang, clinic, choice)` (mockScripts.js:189): home gives `estimate 750, homeVisitFee 150, time 'This evening'`, practice gives `'16:30'`. `buildInsuranceResult` subtracts homeVisitFee before reimbursement (214). Live versions are at livePhoneAgent.js:111-165; the 385 vs 510 figures appear only as a text point (160).
- Plan: PlanPanel.jsx:26-27 shows done text (`t.slotSim`/`t.prepared`), and buttons at 70/79 are `t.prepare` ('Prepare') or `t.call`/`t.callAgain`. summary.js:26-47 prints the plan, estimate and insurance lines. There is no calendar, taxi or option-A/B card UI.

**2. /api/v1/demo/mimi** (pawse/demo.py:30, mounted at app.py:171)
- Fields: `id, synthetic, title, notice, costs, calendar{source, free_from:'16:00', appointment:'16:30', taxi:'16:05'}, steps[{time,title,description,lines[{speaker,german,subtitle}], home_lines?}], checklist`.
- costs() (10-23): `treatment 600, remaining_deductible, reimbursement_rate, reimbursed, clinic, home, taxi 25, home_visit_extra 150, assumptions, exclusions, claim_days`. With the demo policy this gives clinic 385 (360 + 25 taxi) and home 510. **360 is not a field**; it is treatment minus reimbursed (outOfPocket).
- Confirmation call: steps[4] (45-47). `lines`: "Die Halterin oder der Halter möchte den Termin um 16:30 Uhr in der Praxis bestätigen…". `home_lines`: "…möchte einen Hausbesuch heute Abend. Können Sie bitte eine genaue Uhrzeit bestätigen?…"
- Taxi call: steps[5] (48-50). "Wir benötigen um 16:05 Uhr ein Taxi zur Tierarztpraxis…" and the reply from "Taxi · simulated": "Ja, eine Katze in der Transportbox ist kein Problem…25 Franken."
- React consumes only steps[2] and steps[3] (livePhoneAgent.js:30). steps[4], steps[5], `calendar`, `home_lines`, `checklist` and `costs.clinic`/`costs.home` (beyond text) are unused.

**3. Voice speed**
- (a) Gradium: no speed, rate or padding param anywhere. voice.py:200-202 sends `{text, voice_id, model_name, output_format:'wav', only_audio}`. gradiumVoice.js:124 sends the TTS WS setup `{type:'setup', model_name, voice_id, output_format:'pcm_24000'}`. SKILL.md:25 only mentions an optional `json_config` with no speed key documented. A client-side option would be `audio.playbackRate` on the `new Audio(url)` in livePhoneAgent.js:93 (German call lines).
- (b) Browser speech: `speak(text, lang, {speed, pitch, rate})` at speech.js:74 sets `u.rate = rate` (99), default 1. livePhoneAgent.js:218 and mockPhoneAgent.js:75 pass only `speed` and `pitch`, never `rate`; add `rate: 1.1` there. Note `speed` (config.js:61 MOCK_SPEED, `?speed=`) only scales timers, and `speed>1` skips voice entirely (speech.js:76). mockVoiceAgent.js:35 handles Pawse's mock English replies.
- (c) Gemini Live: there is no speechConfig in setup (live.py:104-109). Playback is at nativeAudio.js:43-53 (`createBufferSource`), where `node.playbackRate.value` could be set. Both Gemini audio and Gradium replies go through it (geminiLiveAgent.js:29, 88). That change would also need `next += buffer.duration/rate` (line 53).

**4. Camera**
- VoiceCall.jsx:73 uses `useUserMedia({video:true, facing})` and shows it in `<video>` (148, 254).
- `attachMedia({audio, video})` (152) passes video, but geminiLiveAgent.js:132 and liveVoiceAgent.js:366 only use `audio`. Video is a local preview only, as the consent text says (VoiceCall.jsx:228-229).
- Only uploaded still photos are sent, as a Live `video` message (geminiLiveAgent.js:126-131, jpeg/png/webp ≤3 MB).
- No backend endpoint accepts video. models.py:18 allows only image mimes; `/care/requests` takes a photo.

**5. record-real.mjs selectors vs #63/#65**
- PhoneCall.jsx changed only slightly: #63 added `{rail}`, #65 changed the vet result h3. `.pc-listen`, `.pc-gradium input` (shown only while listening), `details.transcript summary`, `.ask-card button` and `t.backToPawse` 'Back to Pawse' are all unchanged.
- **Changed in #63 (LiveHandoff.jsx):**
  - 'Generate German draft' became 'Draft German script' (mjs:123, broken).
  - 'Review before using' became '2 · Review the German script' (mjs:124, broken).
  - The page is now a step flow facts → script → ready.
  - 'Open simulated Mimi phone rehearsal' still exists but is now inside a collapsed `<details className="handoff-more"><summary>More</summary>`, so it needs a click on "More" first (mjs:132/154).
  - The 'Share these facts with Gemini' label is unchanged.
- PlanPanel 'Prepare' is now `t.prepare` ('Prepare'), but after a vet result the vet button reads `t.callAgain`. `.nth(1)` (mjs:152) still targets the insurance row. Primary styling now follows `nextAction`.
- Live mode has no ask-card (see 1), so the race at mjs:138 resolves on 'Back to Pawse'.
- Unchanged: 'Prepare conversation' (ClinicList.jsx:134), 'Agree and start', `.start-btn`, "Pawse's advice".
